❤ Show a Bit of Love

The agent auto-flags centres from their own activity. Managers add the human layer: weekly dated notes plus marking a centre saved. Wins are kept as a record, not deleted.
The wins — centres saved off the watchlist, with their full red → orange → green → saved history. Reopen sends one back to the active Show a Bit of Love list.
👁 Zoom 100%

Prototype Sample data mirroring the real signals plus how the team works. On live data it reads the same collections the coach dashboard uses (education-centers, events, feedbacks), auto-flags notice / red / yellow / green, then saves the manager layer (weekly notes, pause, saved) to a new churn-risk-scores collection. It never changes existing data.

How it works Tier changes, saved marks and weekly notes are saved to Firestore and shared across the team — they survive reloads and show up for everyone signed in. The daily red / yellow / notice flags still come from centre activity; managers override them here.
